correctness.rationale: The Lindblad generator closes exactly on all nine Hermitian second moments. Symbolic substitution yields identically zero residual for the given covariance; a Hilbert-Schmidt dissipativity argument gives uniqueness. A one-variable rational derivative globally proves the unique clipped-linear maximizer, including detuning zero and equality at the onset. Independent nine-variable numerical solves (256) and optimizer inequalities (1750) corroborate algebra; they are diagnostics, not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The result closes a natural operational question—whether increasing only the middle-site phase-noise channel can improve a steady, continuously thermally supplied bosonic current. It provides the exact nontrivial detuning/contact/hopping threshold and globally optimal rate, useful as a precise noise-engineering benchmark. This is not merely a normalization check or a low-order small-γ observation, since the global optimization and equality classification exclude nonperturbative hidden maxima.
